EXAM TRAP   Forecast is not budget
The forecast says what could happen; the budget says what management plans and commits to. An answer that treats them as the same thing misses management's decisions on price and promotion.

EXAM TRAP   Watch the signs
Ending inventory is added and beginning inventory is subtracted. Reversing the signs, or setting ending stock from this quarter's sales instead of next quarter's, gives the wrong production figure.
